reviews.review: Redfall is a fun game but there is some minor diffuculties such as; Random log outs or crashing, losing items after a crash ect. But overall it is addicting fun and challenging in fun ways that make it worth it on some levels.

I know someone liking this game seems odd but i'll be honest this game is so far from perfect or even necessarily good but I really enjoyed this game. I had fun. The game has the Arkane DNA somewhat but does not feel like dishonored or prey. I would rank the game quaility wise a 5/10 on the current (and last) patch. Fun factor a 6.5/10 overall a fun game that if youre a fan of arkane you may like. HOWEVER buy this on sale do NOT pay full price for this.

I'm gonna be honest i tried to give this game a fair chance but it honestly was everything far from good. I had hopes for the game to be atleast a decent one but it ended up just being a mind numbing experience, and getting something like that from the guys that made the Dishonored games or Prey is honestly crazy.
The game is filled with those little Immersive Sims things, even the game tells you that you can reach places in however many ways you like, but it just feels underbaked. They shoved so much into this game and then tried to make it a Multiplayer live service wannabe only for it to bite them back. It's sad that this will be the hill that Arkane Austin will die on...
